title: Audit robots.txt, sitemap.xml and canonical tags on all zedu.chat marketing pages
description: Fetch zedu.chat/robots.txt and zedu.chat/sitemap.xml. Record the HTTP status, content-type and content of each. Then check every primary marketing page (home, /pricing, /about, /products/channels, /products/buzz, /products/files, /solutions/bootcamps, /solutions/schools, /solutions/universities, /download) for: a valid rel=canonical tag, inclusion in the sitemap, and whether robots.txt blocks it. Deliver a table: page URL | in sitemap | robots directive | canonical present | canonical value | status (correct / problem). Every result dated from today's live fetch. This is the evidence baseline for the roadmap.

goal.title: Achieve Core SEO Compliance for the Website
goal.description: Success means passing a comprehensive technical SEO audit. The agents should identify missing meta titles and descriptions, fix broken links (404s), and ensure all images have proper alt text. Context: We want to achieve a minimum SEO score of 90 on Google Lighthouse.

workstream.title: Evidence-based implementation roadmap and verification protocol for Achieve Core SEO Compliance for the Webs
workstream.description: A structured, milestone-driven approach for 'Achieve Core SEO Compliance for the Website'. 1) Baseline audit and requirement gathering from verified sources. 2) Execution of core marketing/technical deliverables with explicit acceptance criteria. 3) Verification testing and documentation handoff. Deliverables: Audit findings sheet, implementation artifacts, and verified test results.
